description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal full-time role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of patient care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and compliance within a supportive environment. We are looking for a leader who is passionate about nursing excellence and committed to fostering a positive and effective clinical team.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, including staff management, patient care planning, regulatory compliance, and quality improvement initiatives. This role requires a visionary leader with a strong clinical background and a proven track record in a skilled nursing facility. Join a team that values compassion, integrity, and professional growth, and make a significant impact on the lives of residents and staff.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Proven ability to manage and mentor nursing staff.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 to $95,000 based on experience.
